review: Selected indexed primary passages, including primary abstract-level accounts. No complete PDF, visual, supplement, human/domain, full status or independent-dataset review claimed.

rights.access: Primary publisher/PMC passages through session web search; no access bypass.
rights.processing: Selected factual paraphrases and independent editorial guidance.
rights.rawRetention: No raw papers, abstracts, complete source tables or figures retained.
rights.aiTransmission: No separate external model service; analysis of session-exposed passages only.
rights.display: Original selected factual notes and independent planning, not replacement papers or reconstructed source tables.
rights.export: Same permitted original editorial fields as displayed.
rights.license: Exact full-text license/version remains unassessed. No protected source expression or assets reproduced.

provenance.title: Preparation and measurement
provenance.locator: Case-study testing and LCA functional-unit passages

limitations: Retrieve the cement/hybrid contribution, inventory allocation, tile performance and avoided-product assumptions before comparing cases.
A favorable modeled avoidance result is not a measured emissions reduction. Keep the two residue technologies and their functional requirements distinct.
Selected primary passages only: complete outcome inventories, figures, supplements, sample uncertainty and source-status checks remain incomplete.

provenance.title: Preparation and measurement
provenance.locator: Mechanical test and masonry bond descriptions

limitations: Retrieve fabric orientation, matrix thickness, grip and bond length before comparing the three response stages or substrate performance.
A tensile curve does not replace a debonding test. Textile, matrix and substrate failures need separate interpretation.
Selected primary passages only: complete outcome inventories, figures, supplements, sample uncertainty and source-status checks remain incomplete.
Retrieve the MPa/kg index definition, forming/cure schedule and applicable product tests before quoting this as compressive strength.
A mass-normalized optimization index is not a stress value or proof of all-standard compliance. Preserve the exact metric rather than converting its unit silently.
Selected primary passages only: complete outcome inventories, figures, supplements, sample uncertainty and source-status checks remain incomplete.

provenance.title: Selected outcome and boundary
provenance.locator: Results, HBF compression and model error

limitations: Retrieve the length pair, fiber weight basis, mix workability and prediction-domain definition before applying the coefficient.
A qualitative trend match does not establish accurate prediction. Fiber combinations and fresh-property penalties remain part of the design.
Selected primary passages only: complete outcome inventories, figures, supplements, sample uncertainty and source-status checks remain incomplete.
Retrieve marble assay, reactive co-binders, plant mixing sequence and temperature range before treating marble as the sole reactive precursor.
A plant demonstration does not qualify every marble-waste source or establish code compliance. Keep scale-specific placement and material controls visible.
Selected primary passages only: complete outcome inventories, figures, supplements, sample uncertainty and source-status checks remain incomplete.
